5cdab1dbbd8e99c3.title: Book Club for Adults — In-Person Program
5cdab1dbbd8e99c3.desc: Quill has lived on the Red Pine reservation in Minnesota her whole life. She knows what happens to women who look like her. So when she hears a second woman has been stolen, she is determined to do something about it—starting with investigating the group of men working the pipeline construction just north of their homes. As Quill closes in on the truth about the missing women, someone else disappears. In her quest to find justice for all of the women of the reservation, she is confronted with the hard truths of their home and the people who purport to serve them. As Quill puts everything on the line to make a difference, the novel asks searing questions about bystander culture, the reverberations of even one act of crime, and the long-lasting trauma of being considered invisible.
